notes.title: Update 4.4 out now!
notes.content:
Update 4.4 - NEW MATCHMAKING
The matchmaking system has been revamped! Get matches significantly faster with better accuracy!
Balancing on Lazer and Sharp Lazer
New Card 'Clown Pie' coming out with November Season!
Small updates to some portal level designs

Changes to trophy wins/loses:
Player will now always lose at least 5 trophies and win at least 5 trophies after arena 10 when playing against a human
There were some miscalculations in creating the player "hidden" elo (that is used to calculate win/lose trophies) which might have resulted in unbalanced matches and unfair trophy win/lose calculations. We have attempted a fix for this now to better balance the Trophies that are gained/lost in Deep Space.

There is also a new setting in the Settings menu to turn off bots. This might be especially useful for very high level players who have had issues finding a suitable opponent and would like to wait a bit more to find a human opponent.

notes.title: Update 4.0 live now
notes.content:
[b]WELCOME TO TROPHY ROAD[/b]

[b]NEW TROPHY SYSTEM IS HERE! [/b]
- Skulls have been replaced by Trophies!
- Ranking up through the Cosmos will be done by getting Trophies by winning games!
- The Cosmos ranks have been fully redesigned and players have been given a new Cosmos rank when they update the game!
- Three new Portals await: Yum Yum Galaxy Portal, Splendid Splatter Portal and Good Game portal with 45 new level designs!
- New DEEP SPACE Cosmos awaits after reaching the end of Mystic Maintenance Galaxy - And with it a new Elo-style progression for a more competitive end game! Can you reach the Master Rank? 

[b]PLAYER LEVEL IS NOW INCREASED BY UPGRADING CARDS[/b]
- By upgrading cards, you will gain XP which will increase Character HP!
- NEW Player level goes up to level 35!
- Maximum Character HP is now 300
- UPGRADES ARE FASTER THAN EVER! Before you would've needed 1500 Common Cards to reach card level 12, now you only need 250! That means you will be able to upgrade cards almost 4-6x quicker than before!
- Weapon damages have been updated to reflect the new HP values

NEW DAILY DEALS in shop!
- Buy a collection of cards in the shop with deals changing daily! You can also watch an ad to reroll a new set of deals! 

- Boom Boxes now have a more stable spread of cards! That means you will get an almost equal amount of different cards in a Boom Box instead of getting only a big amount of 1 card.

- SWAG is now a lot cheaper in the shop! 

- Bunch of bug fixes and smaller improvements as well!
-Fixes

Support requests will be slower during the holiday season, thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Update 3.2: BOOM BOXES
notes.content:
Hello Community! Update 3.2 BOOM BOXES is here, and it's a big one!

The update is rolling out now on Google Play and the App Store.

NEW 
[list]
[*] New Boom Boxes, can be collected by winning matches. There are 4 different types of Boom Boxes. Boom Boxes get more powerful with each player level, and cap out at player level 6. After waiting a while, you can open them for cards and coins!You can gain a lot more cards compared to the old main menu capsules, and you don't have to watch ads to open them!
[*] New Main Menu layout. Characters can be seen in main menu. Updated screen in many parts of the UI
[*] New Coin prices to adjust for the new upgrade values. Players should also get more coins per day than before.
[*] The character, shop and accessory capsules in the shop are cheaper
[*] Changed card rarities for some cards and mana cost tweaks
[*] Cosmos is now under the skull slider. The skull slider shows the player's progress to the next level instead of the next Cosmos step.
[*] New card ugprade prices. It will be cheaper to upgrade cards in the first few levels.
[*] Season Pass will now only lasts for one calendar month instead of 30 days. Those with an active season pass when updating will get next month for free.
[*] Some map tweaks to Macaroni and Winterland for fairer matches
[*] Seasons open at player level 2, trophy collecting opens at level 2
[/list]

There are a lot more minor tweaks, polish and fixes as well. Happy Slinging!

notes.title: Major Update 3.0 Out now!
notes.content:
UPDATE 3.0 IS OUT NOW! 

MASSIVE REBALANCE UPDATE! Almost all weapon values have been tweaked, physics force now works more accurately and feels snappier!

NEW Card levels, card levels go up to 10!
NEW Get 4-6 coins from every win!
NEW Card & Player health values!
NEW EPIC REWARDS, 25 steps of rewards!
NEW 20 minute capsule in main menu!
NEW Card unlock order!
NEW Skull Box in main menu, get a reward every time you collect 30 skulls!
In addition, lots of other tweaks, bug fixes and improvements. Happy Slinging!

We've massively tweaked both weapon upgrade values and changed player health scaling. We've noticed that there weren't enough reasons to upgrade weapons since the damage and force are relatively the same even if you level up multiple times. Also, player level ups do not feel meaningful since the relative health increase is quite small.

We want level ups to feel powerful and make it worthwhile to upgrade cards! We've tweaked the general progression path so in the first player levels, your health increases significantly. In addition, players who have played a longer time will be relatively closer to each other. This makes matches against two higher-level players more fair, and a better incentive for lower level players to level up. The same progression applies to weapons. A level 1 Bullet will deal only 10 damage, but a level 4 bullet will deal 32 damage! In addition, weapons go up to level 10! A level 10 Force Shot is quite the sight!

We've given care and attention to a lot of weapons that haven't been touched for a long time. We've tweaked each weapon to feel more fun and purposeful. There were a lot of weapons that felt same-y so we've pushed them to fulfil their purpose better. For example, Big Boom does a lot of push-back (and has a new shockwave effect!) but not a lot of damage, while TNT deals a lot of damage but not a lot of force. 

We are making this game for YOU so we appreciate all the feedback and thoughts on the new balance levels! Head to the Official Boom Slingers Discord Server at discord.gg/boomslingers to tell us what you think about he update.

Happy Slinging!
